outcomes.name: ready
outcomes.when: The design is written and the first wave of tickets is ready to file.

outcomes.name: open questions
outcomes.when: The epic can't be planned without answers only a person can give.

outcomes.name: approved
outcomes.when: Approve

outcomes.name: sent back
outcomes.when: Send back with a note

outcomes.name: parked
outcomes.when: Park it

outcomes.name: opened
outcomes.when: The feature branch exists on the remote of every repository.

outcomes.name: blocked
outcomes.when: The branch couldn't be pushed somewhere and a person should look.

outcomes.name: filed
outcomes.when: Every ticket of the approved wave is filed under the epic.

outcomes.name: blocked
outcomes.when: Some tickets couldn't be filed and a person should look.

outcomes.name: child tickets changed
outcomes.when: childrenChanged

outcomes.name: commented
outcomes.when: newComment

outcomes.name: closed
outcomes.when: ticketClosed

outcomes.name: wait
outcomes.when: Nothing needs doing yet; the wave is still being built.

outcomes.name: wave done
outcomes.when: Every ticket of the current wave is done, or the plan has to change now.

outcomes.name: epic done
outcomes.when: Every ticket is done and the epic asked for nothing more.

outcomes.name: stuck
outcomes.when: A comment asks something only a person can decide.

outcomes.name: next wave
outcomes.when: The next wave of tickets is planned and ready to approve.

outcomes.name: nothing left
outcomes.when: Everything the epic asked for has landed on the feature branch.

outcomes.name: open questions
outcomes.when: The next wave can't be planned without answers only a person can give.

outcomes.name: approved
outcomes.when: Approve

outcomes.name: sent back
outcomes.when: Send back with a note

outcomes.name: parked
outcomes.when: Park it

outcomes.name: opened
outcomes.when: Each repository's feature branch has a pull request into its base.

outcomes.name: blocked
outcomes.when: A pull request couldn't be opened and a person should look.

outcomes.name: merged
outcomes.when: merged

outcomes.name: closed
outcomes.when: closed

outcomes.name: checks failing
outcomes.when: checksFailed

outcomes.name: has conflicts
outcomes.when: conflicted

outcomes.name: done
outcomes.when: What the work was about is closed or moved on.

outcomes.name: blocked
outcomes.when: It can't be closed or moved without a person.
